selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: How many paths to the goal are mentioned at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: Two paths.

questions.question: What big thing can be seen happening in the sky and on the earth?
questions.answer: Everything is being changed and renewed in an ordered way.

questions.question: What is seen inside this wise and ongoing activity?
questions.answer: Lordship is seen in it.

questions.question: What is seen inside that merciful lordship?
questions.answer: Godhood is recognized in it.

questions.question: What kind of Being is understood from these actions behind the veil?
questions.answer: A Being with full power and full knowledge.

questions.question: After the actions are noticed, what is understood next?
questions.answer: Allah’s Names are seen through them.

questions.question: After the Beautiful Names are understood, what comes next?
questions.answer: The sacred attributes are understood.

questions.question: Name two of the seven sacred attributes in the passage.
questions.answer: Life and Knowledge.

questions.question: What does the passage say with certainty about the One described by these attributes?
questions.answer: He truly exists and is One.

questions.question: Why is this proof very strong?
questions.answer: Because all creation points to it clearly.

questions.question: What does the passage say it will explain in a very short way?
questions.answer: Two paths, two levels of them, and two truths from them.

questions.question: What is the first truth mostly about?
questions.answer: The ordered working and changing of all things.

questions.question: Does this activity happen only once or keep going?
questions.answer: It keeps going all the time.

questions.question: Where does this activity happen?
questions.answer: In the heavens and on the earth.

questions.question: What does wise activity help us understand about the One doing it?
questions.answer: That the Doer is powerful and knowing.

questions.question: What are we able to notice from the caring and ruling actions?
questions.answer: The Divine Names.

questions.question: What do the Names help us understand after that?
questions.answer: The sacred attributes.

questions.question: Which attribute means Allah can hear?
questions.answer: Hearing.

questions.question: Which attribute means Allah can choose?
questions.answer: Will.

questions.question: What main idea does the first truth teach?
questions.answer: The ordered world shows Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What happens to beings in the passage besides changing?
questions.answer: They are transformed and made new again.

questions.question: Is the activity in the passage random or full of wisdom?
questions.answer: It is full of wisdom.

questions.question: What does “behind a veil” help us understand here?
questions.answer: We do not see Allah directly, but we understand Him from His works.

questions.question: What can be known from the deeds of care and ruling?
questions.answer: Allah’s Names can be known.
